prediction_unit: one vector and label per cohort-qualified donor/sample-group; never repeat labels by cell count

source2.unit: technical group treated as one donor-level prediction sample; biological independence unverified

pooling.name: Cell-type P2
pooling.aggregation: mean of all cells in each donor x cell type, concatenate five blocks; no region reweighting
pooling.missing: per-feature equal-donor observed SOURCE mean; apply unchanged to TARGET
pooling.all_source_missing_feature: fail and report; do not fill from TARGET
pooling.unknown_cells: retain in annotation audit; exclude from the five P2 blocks

preprocessing.imputation_fit: equal-donor vectors from all three labelled SOURCE cohorts only
preprocessing.scaler: StandardScaler fitted to imputed donor vectors from all three SOURCE cohorts only

annotation.unmatched: Unknown; retained in audit and excluded from P2 blocks

comparison.fit: equal-SOURCE subsample of at most20000 train cells per SOURCE; SOURCE-only RNA scaler
comparison.visualization: 2D PCA fitted on imputed standardized SOURCE donor vectors, transform TARGET; display only

disease_training_labels: all reliable labelled units in three SOURCE cohorts; no TARGET units
supersedes: rev03 three-fold primary analysis; retired_legacy_cohort excluded from all new training and evaluation
reporting: every fold and seed; mean/sampleSD; equal-fold macro average; no seed selection
target_policy: no TARGET labels/metrics for annotation, preprocessing, fitting, checkpoint selection or probe tuning

biology.groups: frozen TARGET predicted AD vs predicted Control
biology.differential: donor mean full-gene CP10K log1p RNA, Welch t-test and BH; exploratory prediction-defined groups
biology.evaluability: at least2 units per predicted group; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
biology.effect: log2 ratio of group means of donor mean CP10K, pseudocount1
biology.genes: all36601 aligned genes; test only genes detected in at least2 TARGET units; never select by true diagnosis
biology.ora: GO_BP2025 and Reactome2022; hypergeometric plus BH; background=all tested mapped genes
biology.query: FDR<0.05 and abs(log2FC)>0.25; top200 per direction by FDR,pvalue,geneID
biology.note: posthoc associations of expression-derived predictions; not independent confirmation of disease mechanisms

training_authorization: four-fold three-seed Full B2 and RNA-only training/evaluation authorized; preserve historical runs

replacement_cohort.name: GSE288063_GSE278576
replacement_cohort.ad22: two libraries pooled into one donor
replacement_cohort.selection: fixed before model results; HP excluded; five age-matched controls
replacement_cohort.QC: author Library+Barcode metadata subset; raw control droplets excluded
replacement_cohort.gate: verification_report_rev04.json must PASS before any preprocessing
replacement_cohort.donor_overlap: prior audit found no metadata donor-ID overlap; hidden biological overlap not independently excluded

feature_policy.normalization: CP10K on full 36601 stable shared RNA gene dictionary, log1p before feature selection
feature_policy.HVG: per-cohort SOURCE train, equal-donor weights; top2000 intersection if >=256 else frozen equal-rank fallback top2000
feature_policy.ATAC: SOURCE native-peak interval union; TARGET peaks not used; existing overlap mapping and B_D/F formulas retained
feature_policy.new_donor_split: seed20020130; frozen historical donor-stratified 20% validation rule; ad22 libraries never split
feature_policy.existing_splits: reuse exact historical donor splits; GSE268609 all 13 technical groups train, no invented validation
